SimulationRun.title: SimulationRun
SimulationRun.description: A simulation run: tenant-scoped, content-addressed identity (digest over the canonical invocation payload), exact-revision invocation and simulator references, opaque capability bindings, the append-only sealed state chain, and (on completion) the sealed result.

SimulationFabricRecordVersion.title: SimulationFabricRecordVersion
SimulationFabricRecordVersion.description: Version discriminator carried by every serialized simulation-fabric record and snapshot (currently 1).

SimulationRunId.title: SimulationRunId
SimulationRunId.description: Simulation run identity: "simrun:" followed by a lowercase slug (derived deterministically from the run identity digest).

TenantId.title: TenantId
TenantId.description: Opaque tenant identity: "tenant:" followed by a lowercase slug.

SimulationRunStatus.title: SimulationRunStatus
SimulationRunStatus.description: One run lifecycle status: submitted, scheduled, running, or the terminal completed / failed / cancelled.

InvocationReference.title: InvocationReference
InvocationReference.description: Exact-revision invocation reference: request id plus the SHA-256 digest of the request canonical JSON.

MessageId.title: MessageId
MessageId.description: Opaque message identifier, unique within the emitting scope.

SimulatorReference.title: SimulatorReference
SimulatorReference.description: Exact-revision simulator reference: id plus the SHA-256 digest of the registration canonical JSON.

SimulatorId.title: SimulatorId
SimulatorId.description: Registered simulator identifier: "simulator:" followed by a lowercase slug.

CapabilityBindingRef.title: CapabilityBindingRef
CapabilityBindingRef.description: Opaque typed reference to a W007 capability registration: capability id, semver version, and the registration manifest digest (the exact-revision pin). Never a structural copy of the registry record.

FabricIdempotencyKey.title: FabricIdempotencyKey
FabricIdempotencyKey.description: A submission idempotency key: caller-supplied opaque token, or the derived content key (lowercase hex SHA-256).

SimulationRunState.title: SimulationRunState
SimulationRunState.description: One sealed, content-addressed run-state record: status, the typed transition that produced it, the previousRunDigest chain link, and its own SHA-256 content address (append-only; W023 version-chain style).

RunTransition.title: RunTransition
RunTransition.description: One typed run-state transition: cause, acting principal (provenance), and the caller-supplied instant; the genesis record carries from: null.

RunTransitionCause.title: RunTransitionCause
RunTransitionCause.description: The typed cause of a run-state transition: submission, planning, dispatch, result-ingested, execution-failed, result-rejected, or cancellation.

FabricPrincipalId.title: FabricPrincipalId
FabricPrincipalId.description: Acting principal of a fabric operation: "principal:" followed by a lowercase slug (the W009/W010 actor grammar, mirrored).

Timestamp.title: Timestamp
Timestamp.description: UTC instant in canonical form YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.mmmZ (exactly three fractional digits, Z suffix).

SealedSimulationResult.title: SealedSimulationResult
SealedSimulationResult.description: A sealed simulation result: the admitted W005 SimulationResult document plus its canonical SHA-256 digest (the exact-revision address of the prediction artifact).

SimulationResult.title: SimulationResult
SimulationResult.description: Simulation result message: exact-revision request and simulator bindings, completed/failed outcome, and the determinism claim.

SimulationProtocolVersion.title: SimulationProtocolVersion
SimulationProtocolVersion.description: Exact simulation-protocol version admitted by this release ("1.0.0").

SimulationOutcome.title: SimulationOutcome
SimulationOutcome.description: Exhaustive simulation outcome union: completed (with outputs) or failed (with a failure).

CompletedSimulationResult.title: CompletedSimulationResult
CompletedSimulationResult.description: Completed simulation outcome: at least one named output value.

FailedSimulationResult.title: FailedSimulationResult
FailedSimulationResult.description: Failed simulation outcome: machine-readable failure code and reason.

SimulationFailure.title: SimulationFailure
SimulationFailure.description: A simulation failure: machine-readable code plus a human-auditable reason.

SimulationFailureCode.title: SimulationFailureCode
SimulationFailureCode.description: Machine-readable failure code carried by failed simulation results.
